title: Croydon Roll
description: A nocturnal breakbeat-led garage roller at 135 BPM, driven by a funky rolling sub bassline and a chopped soul vocal that mutates over the arc. Ghosted LinnDrum hits and swung euclidean hats carry dub-organ stabs through filter opens, ply fills and a delay-soaked breakdown before rolling back out.
code:
setcpm(135/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [~ bd]").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.85).shape(0.2).room(0.2),
    s("hh(5,8,2)").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.45).swingBy(0.18, 8).lpf(saw.slow(8).range(700, 2600)),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(280).gain(0.85).shape(0.15)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [bd bd]").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.88).shape(0.25).room(0.2),
    s("hh(7,8,2)").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.5).swingBy(0.2, 8).cut(1).lpf(tri.slow(16).range(900, 3200)),
    s("~ rim ~ rim").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.5).crush(7),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(saw.slow(16).range(260, 720)).gain(0.9).shape(0.18),
    s("apache").chop(8).speed("<1 1 1.5 0.5>").gain(0.55).vowel("<a e o>").room(0.3).delay(".4:.1875:.55")
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [bd bd]").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.9).shape(0.3).room(0.2).every(8, x => x.ply("<1 1 2 4>")),
    s("hh(7,8,2)").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.5).swingBy(0.2, 8).cut(1).lpf(2800).every(4, x => x.rev()),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.5).room(0.25),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(saw.slow(16).range(280, 900)).gain(0.95).shape(0.2).off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.5)),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [eb3,g3,bb3,d4] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("triangle").gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.35, 0.75)).lpf(2200).delay(".5:.125:.5").room(0.3),
    s("apache").chop(8).speed("<1 1.5 0.5 2>").gain(0.55).vowel("<a e o>").sometimesBy(0.25, x => x.speed(2)).room(0.3).delay(".4:.1875:.55")
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(saw.slow(8).range(220, 600)).gain(0.85).shape(0.15),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [eb3,g3,bb3,d4] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("swpad").gain(0.5).lpf(1600).room(0.5).delay(".6:.25:.6"),
    s("apache").slice(8, "0 2 4 6 1 5 3 7").speed("<1 0.5>").gain(0.5).vowel("<o a>").delay(".5:.1875:.6").room(0.4)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [bd bd]").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.92).shape(0.32).room(0.2).every(4, x => x.ply("<1 2 1 4>")),
    s("hh(7,8,2)").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.52).swingBy(0.22, 8).cut(1).lpf(3200).degradeBy(0.15),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.5).room(0.25).every(8, x => x.ply(2)),
    s("oh ~ oh ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.4).cut(1),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(saw.slow(8).range(300, 1100)).gain(0.98).shape(0.22).off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.5)),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [eb3,g3,bb3,d4] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("triangle").gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.4, 0.8)).lpf(2600).crush(8).delay(".5:.125:.5"),
    s("apache").chop(8).speed("<1.5 0.5 2 1>").gain(0.55).vowel("<a e o i>").sometimesBy(0.3, x => x.rev()).delay(".4:.1875:.55")
  )],
  [12, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [~ bd]").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.85).shape(0.2).room(0.2),
    s("hh(5,8,2)").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.42).swingBy(0.18, 8).lpf(tri.slow(8).range(2400, 800)),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(saw.slow(8).range(900, 240)).gain(0.85).shape(0.15).delay(".4:.1875:.5")
  )]
)
